snippet.title: C64 Game - 3D Tic Tac Toe
snippet.description:
The (futile) challenge...

To play and record as many c64 games as possible. The games will be recorded sequentially in the order they appear in the fantastic GameBase64 frontend. 
I obviously only have knowledge of a tiny percentage of these games, so please go easy on me when I clearly don't have a clue. Quite a large proportion of the games in the database are written in languages other than English - I will only play these if they are not text-heavy and the game objective is clear(ish)
